reason: Shoes that cost 30,000 on Taobao end up at 51,000 at my door, and I can find something close in the local market or on an Instagram page for 30 to 35 thousand without waiting three weeks. For the small cheap things I actually want, the per-kilo shipping and the minimum fee eat the whole saving.
objection: The fees are almost as much as the item itself. Shipping by the kilo makes small, cheap fashion and beauty items not worth it, so where is my saving?
would_change_my_mind: If I could combine several small items into one shipment and pay shipping by actual weight, not a full kilo, so a few small pieces come to well under 10,000 in fees.
